question: Why must the teaching be withheld from one hostile to the yoginis and disobedient to the guru?
premises: Hostility toward the yoginis is named as a fault.
Transgression of the guru’s command is named as a fault.
Such faults mark a person as unfit.
inference: One who is hostile to the yoginis and violates the guru’s command must not receive the teaching.
plain_english: And not to one hostile to the yoginis, or to one who transgresses the guru’s command.
